Cgv.metaDescription: Read our terms and conditions of sale.
Cgv.title: Terms and Conditions of Sale

articles.title: Article 1 – Purpose
articles.content: These general conditions of sale (CGV) govern all transactions carried out on the specpart.tn website. Any order implies unconditional acceptance of these CGV.

articles.title: Article 2 – Products
articles.content: The products offered for sale are described as accurately as possible. The product photographs are not contractual. specpart is committed to offering only 100% authentic products certified by partner brands.

articles.title: Article 3 – Prices
articles.content: Prices are given in Tunisian Dinar (DT) including all taxes (TTC). specpart reserves the right to modify its prices at any time, but products will be billed based on the rates in effect at the time of order validation.

articles.title: Article 4 – Orders
articles.content: The customer places an order on the specpart.tn website. Validating the order implies acceptance of these CGV and constitutes a sales contract. specpart will confirm the order by email.

articles.title: Article 5 – Shipping
articles.content: Delivery is made to the address indicated during the order. Delivery times are 24 to 48 business hours throughout Tunisia. Delivery is free for all orders over 100 DT.

articles.title: Article 6 – Payment
articles.content: Payment can be made by: cash on delivery, bank transfer, or online credit card. All online transactions are secure.

articles.title: Article 7 – Right of Withdrawal
articles.content: In accordance with current legislation, the customer has a period of 14 days from receipt of their order to exercise their right of withdrawal, without having to justify reasons. The product must be returned in its original packaging, unopened and unused.

articles.title: Article 8 – Complaints
articles.content: For any complaint, the customer can contact customer service by email at specpart@hotmail.com or by phone at +216 29 294 195.
